verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state skills are written as plain editable files into the repo ('ordinary files you own and can edit', 'copies editable skill files into your project') and are portable across harnesses ('Works with any agent Claude Code · Cursor · Codex · Copilot'), directly matching the story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that files are literally markdown viewable outside the tool, and no evidence of an actual cross-harness migration test by a third party.
